1	import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
2	import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
3	
4	import '../../../../core/design_tokens.dart';
5	import '../../../../core/di/injection_container.dart';
6	import '../../../../core/failure/failure.dart';
7	import '../../../../core/widgets/app_drawer.dart';
8	import '../../../capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart';
9	import '../../../capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart';
10	import '../../../capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart';
11	import '../../../capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart';
12	import '../cubit/chat_cubit.dart';
13	import '../cubit/chat_state.dart';
14	import '../widgets/chat_bubble.dart';
15	
16	/// Tela 1 — Home/Chat, RF04's first real (non-placeholder) screen: the
17	/// same dark-green header + drawer chrome the deleted
18	/// `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` used, now with a real message list and
19	/// composer. [cubit] is injected rather than resolved internally
20	/// (`sl<ChatCubit>()` stays the router's own job, Code Map), so a test can
21	/// pass a fake-repository-backed instance directly.
22	class ChatScreen extends StatefulWidget {
23	  const ChatScreen({required this.cubit, super.key});
24	
25	  final ChatCubit cubit;
26	
27	  @override
28	  State<ChatScreen> createState() => _ChatScreenState();
29	}
30	
31	class _ChatScreenState extends State<ChatScreen> {
32	  final _textController = TextEditingController();
33	  final _scrollController = ScrollController();
34	
35	  @override
36	  void initState() {
37	    super.initState();
38	    // `ChatCubit.init()`'s own no-op guard makes this safe to call on
39	    // every mount (Boundaries: "silently ensure one Chat Session exists").
40	    widget.cubit.init();
41	  }
42	
43	  @override
44	  void dispose() {
45	    _textController.dispose();
46	    _scrollController.dispose();
47	    super.dispose();
48	  }
49	
50	  void _send() {
51	    final text = _textController.text;
52	    if (text.trim().isEmpty) {
53	      return;
54	    }
55	    widget.cubit.sendMessage(text);
56	    _textController.clear();
57	  }
58	
59	  /// Only jumps to the bottom when the view was already there (or close
60	  /// to it) *before* this update, or hasn't attached to a scrollable yet
61	  /// (the very first history render) — otherwise a user who deliberately
62	  /// scrolled up to reread earlier history would get yanked back down on
63	  /// every single streamed token.
64	  void _scrollToBottomSoon() {
65	    if (_scrollController.hasClients) {
66	      final position = _scrollController.position;
67	      const nearBottomThreshold = 80.0;
68	      final wasNearBottom =
69	          position.maxScrollExtent - position.pixels <= nearBottomThreshold;
70	      if (!wasNearBottom) {
71	        return;
72	      }
73	    }
74	    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
75	      if (_scrollController.hasClients) {
76	        _scrollController.jumpTo(_scrollController.position.maxScrollExtent);
77	      }
78	    });
79	  }
80	
81	  @override
82	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
83	    return BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value(
84	      value: widget.cubit,
85	      child: Scaffold(
86	        backgroundColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceBg,
87	        drawer: const AppDrawer(),
88	        // Boundaries: "heavier drawer scrim rgba(36,31,25,.4)" — overrides
89	        // `Scaffold`'s own default barrier, same convention the deleted
90	        // `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` already used.
91	        drawerScrimColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy,
92	        body: Column(
93	          children: [
94	            const _ChatHeader(),
95	            Expanded(
96	              child: BlocConsumer<ChatCubit, ChatState>(
97	                listener: (context, state) {
98	                  if (state is ChatReady) {
99	                    _scrollToBottomSoon();
100	                  }
101	                },
102	                builder: (context, state) => switch (state) {
103	                  ChatBootstrapLoading() => const Center(
104	                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(
105	                      color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
106	                    ),
107	                  ),
108	                  ChatBootstrapError(failure: final failure) =>
109	                    _ChatBootstrapErrorView(failure: failure),
110	                  ChatReady(messages: final messages) => ListView.builder(
111	                    controller: _scrollController,
112	                    padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
113	                    itemCount: messages.length,
114	                    itemBuilder: (context, index) => ChatBubble(
115	                      key: ValueKey(messages[index].id),
116	                      message: messages[index],
117	                    ),
118	                  ),
119	                },
120	              ),
121	            ),
122	            _ChatComposer(controller: _textController, onSend: _send),
123	          ],
124	        ),
125	      ),
126	    );
127	  }
128	}
129	
130	/// The same dark-green header + ☰-opens-drawer wiring the deleted
131	/// `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` used — moved here verbatim rather than
132	/// shared from a common widget, since that screen is deleted wholesale
133	/// (Code Map) and no third screen needs this exact header yet.
134	class _ChatHeader extends StatelessWidget {
135	  const _ChatHeader();
136	
137	  @override
138	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
139	    return Container(
140	      color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
141	      padding: DesignTokens.navHeaderPadding,
142	      child: Builder(
143	        builder: (context) => Row(
144	          children: [
145	            GestureDetector(
146	              onTap: () => Scaffold.of(context).openDrawer(),
147	              child: const Icon(
148	                Icons.menu,
149	                size: DesignTokens.navMenuIconSize,
150	                color: DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary,
151	              ),
152	            ),
153	            Expanded(
154	              child: Text(
155	                'Cerne',
156	                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
157	                style: DesignTokens.textTitleLg.copyWith(
158	                  color: DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary,
159	                ),
160	              ),
161	            ),
162	            const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.navMenuIconSize),
163	          ],
164	        ),
165	      ),
166	    );
167	  }
168	}
169	
170	/// I/O matrix: "Bootstrap failure" — a generic error state, not an
171	/// infinite spinner; no retry action exists yet (Boundaries: the
172	/// retry-tap action belongs to Story 6.2–6.5).
173	class _ChatBootstrapErrorView extends StatelessWidget {
174	  const _ChatBootstrapErrorView({required this.failure});
175	
176	  final Failure failure;
177	
178	  @override
179	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
180	    return Center(
181	      child: Padding(
182	        padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
183	        child: Column(
184	          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
185	          children: [
186	            const Icon(
187	              Icons.error_outline,
188	              size: DesignTokens.spacing2xl,
189	              color: DesignTokens.colorError,
190	            ),
191	            const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
192	            Text(
193	              'Não foi possível carregar a conversa',
194	              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
195	              style: DesignTokens.textHeadlineMd.copyWith(
196	                color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
197	              ),
198	            ),
199	          ],
200	        ),
201	      ),
202	    );
203	  }
204	}
205	
206	/// The composer row — "+" (`InsertionModal.show`, unchanged), a text
207	/// field (placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...") and a send icon. The
208	/// text field and send icon are disabled while the bootstrap hasn't
209	/// resolved yet or while an AI bubble is still `streaming` (Code
210	/// Map/`ChatCubit.sendMessage`'s own same-shaped guard); the "+" stays
211	/// tappable regardless, same as the deleted placeholder's own
212	/// always-tappable "+" — never a dedicated offline banner/lock, that's
213	/// Story 6.3's job (Boundaries).
214	class _ChatComposer extends StatelessWidget {
215	  const _ChatComposer({required this.controller, required this.onSend});
216	
217	  final TextEditingController controller;
218	  final VoidCallback onSend;
219	
220	  @override
221	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
222	    return BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>(
223	      builder: (context, state) {
224	        final canSend = state is ChatReady && !state.isSending;
225	        return SafeArea(
226	          top: false,
227	          child: Padding(
228	            padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
229	            child: Row(
230	              children: [
231	                Semantics(
232	                  button: true,
233	                  label: 'Adicionar registro',
234	                  excludeSemantics: true,
235	                  child: IconButton(
236	                    onPressed: () => InsertionModal.show(
237	                      context,
238	                      cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>(),
239	                      audioCubit: sl<AudioEntryCubit>(),
240	                      photoCubit: sl<PhotoEntryCubit>(),
241	                    ),
242	                    icon: const Icon(Icons.add, color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary),
243	                  ),
244	                ),
245	                Expanded(
246	                  child: TextField(
247	                    controller: controller,
248	                    enabled: canSend,
249	                    // `chat-messages-send`'s own request schema caps
250	                    // `content` at 8000 characters (openapi.yaml) — a
251	                    // client-side cap surfaces that limit directly
252	                    // instead of letting an over-length message fail
253	                    // only after a round trip, indistinguishable from a
254	                    // dropped connection.
255	                    maxLength: 8000,
256	                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.send,
257	                    onSubmitted: canSend ? (_) => onSend() : null,
258	                    style: DesignTokens.textBodyLg.copyWith(
259	                      color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
260	                    ),
261	                    decoration: InputDecoration(
262	                      hintText: 'Escreva uma mensagem...',
263	                      counterText: '',
264	                      contentPadding: DesignTokens.textFieldContentPadding,
265	                      border: const OutlineInputBorder(
266	                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(
267	                          Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusFull),
268	                        ),
269	                        borderSide: BorderSide(
270	                          color: DesignTokens.colorBorder,
271	                          width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault,
272	                        ),
273	                      ),
274	                      enabledBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
275	                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(
276	                          Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusFull),
277	                        ),
278	                        borderSide: BorderSide(
279	                          color: DesignTokens.colorBorder,
280	                          width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault,
281	                        ),
282	                      ),
283	                      focusedBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
284	                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(
285	                          Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusFull),
286	                        ),
287	                        borderSide: BorderSide(
288	                          color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
289	                          width: DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis,
290	                        ),
291	                      ),
292	                    ),
293	                  ),
294	                ),
295	                Semantics(
296	                  button: true,
297	                  label: 'Enviar mensagem',
298	                  excludeSemantics: true,
299	                  child: IconButton(
300	                    onPressed: canSend ? onSend : null,
301	                    icon: Icon(
302	                      Icons.send,
303	                      color: canSend
304	                          ? DesignTokens.colorPrimary
305	                          : DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
306	                    ),
307	                  ),
308	                ),
309	              ],
310	            ),
311	          ),
312	        );
313	      },
314	    );
315	  }
316	}

1	import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
2	import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
3	
4	import '../design_tokens.dart';
5	import '../navigation/app_router.dart';
6	import 'avatar.dart';
7	
8	/// Tela 3 — Menu lateral, the sole navigation hub (Boundaries: "no
9	/// drawer-within-drawer, no tab bar"). Native Flutter `Drawer` (Boundaries:
10	/// "not a hand-rolled overlay like `ConfirmationDialog`").
11	///
12	/// The header shows a generic, non-personalized [Avatar] + static label —
13	/// no real logged-in identity is wired up yet (Boundaries; see
14	/// deferred-work.md for why). There is no `CONVERSAS`/past-session list
15	/// (RF04/RF07 aren't built) — only the static "Novo Chat" action (closes
16	/// the drawer, no-op) and the three nav items.
17	class AppDrawer extends StatefulWidget {
18	  const AppDrawer({super.key});
19	
20	  @override
21	  State<AppDrawer> createState() => _AppDrawerState();
22	}
23	
24	class _AppDrawerState extends State<AppDrawer> {
25	  // Guards every action below against a rapid double-tap (on the same
26	  // item, or a different one) firing `Navigator.of(context).pop()` twice —
27	  // the second call would land after the drawer's own pop already started
28	  // closing it, popping the route beneath the drawer instead of being a
29	  // no-op (code review, Story 1.6).
30	  bool _actionTaken = false;
31	
32	  @override
33	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
34	    return Drawer(
35	      width: DesignTokens.drawerWidth,
36	      backgroundColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
37	      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
38	      // No `SafeArea` here — `drawerContentPadding`'s fixed top value (59)
39	      // already clears the status bar, same convention every other header
40	      // in this story uses (`ChatScreen`'s own header, `_BackArrowHeader`
41	      // in `placeholder_screens.dart`); the epic's fixed 390x844 single
42	      // frame has no responsive/dynamic-inset handling anywhere else, so
43	      // stacking `SafeArea` on top would double-count that clearance.
44	      child: Padding(
45	        padding: DesignTokens.drawerContentPadding,
46	        child: Column(
47	          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
48	          children: [
49	            Container(
50	              padding: DesignTokens.drawerHeaderPadding,
51	              decoration: const BoxDecoration(
52	                border: Border(
53	                  bottom: BorderSide(color: DesignTokens.colorBorder),
54	                ),
55	              ),
56	              child: const Row(
57	                children: [
58	                  Avatar(initials: 'U'),
59	                  SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.drawerHeaderGap),
60	                  Text('Usuário', style: DesignTokens.textTitleSm),
61	                ],
62	              ),
63	            ),
64	            const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
65	            _DrawerPrimaryAction(
66	              icon: Icons.add,
67	              label: 'Novo Chat',
68	              // No real chat yet (RF04/RF07) — closes the drawer, stays
69	              // on `/` (I/O matrix: "drawer closes, stays on /").
70	              onTap: () => _closeDrawer(context),
71	            ),
72	            const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
73	            // Second drawer block (code review, Story 1.6): the prototype's
74	            // own markup groups "Novo Chat" separately from the three
75	            // static nav items below, via a `border-top` + `padding-top`
76	            // on this section (ground truth: `cerne-prototype.html`'s
77	            // `<!-- OVERLAY: Drawer -->` block) — not reproduced until now.
78	            Container(
79	              padding: DesignTokens.drawerSectionDividerPadding,
80	              decoration: const BoxDecoration(
81	                border: Border(
82	                  top: BorderSide(color: DesignTokens.colorBorder),
83	                ),
84	              ),
85	              child: Column(
86	                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
87	                children: [
88	                  _DrawerNavItem(
89	                    icon: Icons.menu_book_outlined,
90	                    label: 'Meus Registros',
91	                    onTap: () =>
92	                        _navigate(context, AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros),
93	                  ),
94	                  _DrawerNavItem(
95	                    icon: Icons.view_kanban_outlined,
96	                    label: 'Planos de Ação',
97	                    onTap: () =>
98	                        _navigate(context, AppRoutePaths.planosDeAcao),
99	                  ),
100	                  _DrawerNavItem(
101	                    icon: Icons.settings_outlined,
102	                    label: 'Configurações',
103	                    onTap: () =>
104	                        _navigate(context, AppRoutePaths.configuracoes),
105	                  ),
106	                ],
107	              ),
108	            ),
109	          ],
110	        ),
111	      ),
112	    );
113	  }
114	
115	  void _closeDrawer(BuildContext context) {
116	    if (_actionTaken) {
117	      return;
118	    }
119	    _actionTaken = true;
120	    Navigator.of(context).pop();
121	  }
122	
123	  void _navigate(BuildContext context, String location) {
124	    if (_actionTaken) {
125	      return;
126	    }
127	    _actionTaken = true;
128	    Navigator.of(context).pop();

4	/// `ChatCubit`'s own sealed state — AD-12: "Chat's state is its own sealed
5	/// class, never forced into `Resource<T>`", because it isn't a single
6	/// fetch (the append-only [ChatReady.messages] list keeps growing one
7	/// token at a time while a response streams in, long after the initial
8	/// bootstrap fetch that produced it has already resolved).
9	sealed class ChatState {
10	  const ChatState();
11	}
12	
13	/// The initial state, and the state while `ChatCubit.init()`'s own
14	/// session-bootstrap (list-or-create-one-session) + history fetch are
15	/// still in flight.
16	class ChatBootstrapLoading extends ChatState {
17	  const ChatBootstrapLoading();
18	}
19	
20	/// I/O matrix: "Bootstrap failure" — `chat-sessions-list`/`create` (or the
21	/// history fetch right after) failed; the screen shows this generic error
22	/// state instead of spinning forever.
23	class ChatBootstrapError extends ChatState {
24	  const ChatBootstrapError(this.failure);
25	
26	  final Failure failure;
27	
28	  @override
29	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
30	      identical(this, other) ||
31	      (other is ChatBootstrapError && other.failure == failure);
32	
33	  @override
34	  int get hashCode => failure.hashCode;
35	}
36	
37	/// The composer is enabled, [messages] renders — [ChatUiMessage]'s own
38	/// [ChatUiMessage.status] drives each bubble's one of the 3 visible states
39	/// (streaming/failed/complete, RF04's Acceptance Criteria).
40	class ChatReady extends ChatState {
41	  const ChatReady({
42	    required this.sessionId,
43	    required this.messages,
44	    this.isSending = false,
45	  });
46	
47	  final String sessionId;
48	
49	  /// Append-only for the lifetime of this cubit (Code Map) — a message is
50	  /// ever only added to the end, or mutated in place by id (a streaming
51	  /// AI bubble's own `content`/`status`), never removed or reordered.
52	  final List<ChatUiMessage> messages;
53	
54	  /// Whether `ChatCubit.sendMessage`'s own send is actively in flight —
55	  /// the composer's one enable/disable signal (`_ChatComposer`). Kept as
56	  /// its own field rather than derived by scanning [messages] for a
57	  /// persisted `streaming` status: a message restored from history/cache
58	  /// can legitimately carry that status without a send being in flight
59	  /// (I/O matrix: mid-stream drop), which would otherwise permanently
60	  /// disable the composer.
61	  final bool isSending;

66	        messages: messages ?? this.messages,

---
title: 'Story 6.2 — Multi-Session Chat History & New Conversation'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: ['{project-root}/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-6-context.md']
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Home/Chat (story 6.1) hard-codes a single auto-bootstrapped session with no way to see past sessions or start a fresh one; `AppDrawer` has no session list at all, just a dead "Novo Chat" button.

**Approach:** Add `ChatCubit.switchSession`/`startNewSession` methods that reuse the existing `listSessions()`/`createSession()` repository calls (already backend-correct — no data-layer change needed), carry the session list and a per-session scroll offset on `ChatReady`, and wire `AppDrawer`'s missing "CONVERSAS" section to read/call that same cubit instance via the `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>` already wrapping the drawer's `Scaffold`.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Drawer session list and "Novo Chat" read `context.read<ChatCubit>()` / `BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>` — the same instance `ChatScreen` already provides via `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value` (`chat_screen.dart:83-87`); never resolve a second `ChatCubit` via `sl<ChatCubit>()` inside `AppDrawer`.
- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` return `Future<Either<Failure, void>>` and are `await`ed by their `AppDrawer` tap handlers — closes the gap spec-6-1's own review flagged (a cubit action's result must be observed by its caller).
- Tapping "Novo Chat" while offline leaves the current session/messages untouched; the caller shows a transient `SnackBar` instead of a dedicated offline banner (Story 6.3's own UI, not built yet).
- Scroll-offset restore is in-memory only, keyed by `sessionId`, held inside `ChatCubit` (never written to Hive) — persists across session switches within one app run, resets on app restart.
- Reuse `_DrawerNavItem`'s existing tokens (`drawerNavItemPadding`, `textBodyMd`, `textMonoCaption` for the timestamp/"CONVERSAS" label) — no new design tokens.
- A session whose `title` is empty renders the fallback label "Nova conversa" (the backend contract leaves an untitled session's `title` value undocumented).

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:** session rename/delete (no backend endpoint exists); paginating the drawer's session list past the backend's default first page (no AC requires `cursor`/`limit` wiring); building Story 6.3's offline composer lock/banner; persisting scroll offset or "last active session" across app restarts.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Switch session | Drawer open, tap a past session row | `ChatReady` updates to that session's history; scroll jumps to its last recorded offset (or bottom if none) | N/A |
| New session online | Tap "Novo Chat" while online | `POST /chat/sessions` succeeds; new empty session becomes active, composer focused, drawer closes | N/A |
| New session offline | Tap "Novo Chat" while offline | `createSession()` resolves `Left(Failure.networkOffline)`; current session stays active, drawer closes, `SnackBar` shown | `Failure.networkOffline` surfaced, no crash |
| Switch to already-active session | Tap the currently open session's own row | No-op reload; drawer just closes | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart:40-69` -- `ChatReady`: add `sessions: List<ChatSession>` and `restoreScrollOffset: double?`, extend `copyWith`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart:64-114` (`_bootstrap`) -- capture the resolved sessions list into the emitted `ChatReady`; add `Map<String, double> _scrollOffsets`, `recordScrollOffset(double)`, `switchSession(String sessionId)`, `startNewSession()` (mirror `_bootstrap`'s match-based error handling, lines 92-113).
- `lib/features/chat/domain/repositories/chat_repository.dart:21,31` -- `listSessions()`/`createSession()` signatures, reused as-is, no change.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart:17-131` -- import `flutter_bloc`, `ChatCubit`, `ChatState`, `ChatSession`; wrap body in `BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>`; insert a "CONVERSAS" section (mirrors the bordered nav-items `Container`, lines 78-108) between `_DrawerPrimaryAction` (65-71) and that `Container`, built only when `state is ChatReady`; wire `_DrawerPrimaryAction.onTap` (70) to `startNewSession()`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart:33,59-79` -- on a `ChatReady` with non-null `restoreScrollOffset`, `jumpTo` it once instead of `_scrollToBottomSoon()`; add a scroll listener calling `cubit.recordScrollOffset`.
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1071-1155` -- `chat.sessions.list` response/cursor shape, confirms no rename/delete endpoint exists.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:128-156` -- `_FakeChatRepository`, the DI-override pattern to extend for drawer/cubit tests.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart` -- add `sessions`/`restoreScrollOffset` to `ChatReady` -- carries drawer + scroll-restore data without a second state container (AD-12-consistent).
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart` -- add `switchSession`, `startNewSession`, `recordScrollOffset`; update `_bootstrap` to populate `sessions` -- single cubit stays the one source of truth for session list + active session.
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- render the CONVERSAS list from `ChatReady.sessions`, wire tap → `switchSession`/`startNewSession`, `await` + `SnackBar` on `Left` -- closes the "no CONVERSAS list" gap (doc comment lines 8-16).
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart` -- scroll-offset capture + restore-on-switch -- fulfils the "returning session restores last scroll position" AC.
- [ ] `test/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit_test.dart` -- unit-test `switchSession`/`startNewSession`/offline-create/no-op-on-same-session per the I/O matrix.
- [ ] `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` (new) -- widget tests for CONVERSAS list rendering, tap-to-switch, "Novo Chat" offline `SnackBar`, mirroring `_FakeChatRepository` (`app_router_test.dart:128-156`).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given existing Chat Sessions, when I open the side menu, then they're listed under "CONVERSAS" and tapping one switches the active conversation.
- Given I tap "Novo Chat", when the new session is created, then it opens empty, composer focused, placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...".
- Given I'm offline, when I tap "Novo Chat", then no session is created, the current conversation is untouched, and I see an error message.
- Given I switch back to a session I was previously scrolled up in, when it loads, then it restores that scroll position instead of jumping to the bottom.

## Design Notes

- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` don't re-emit `ChatBootstrapLoading` — swapping sessions keeps the drawer-closing transition feeling instant; a transient loading flicker isn't worth a 4th visible chat state (Boundaries: "exactly three visible message states" governs bubbles, not session-switch chrome).
- `_scrollOffsets` lives on the cubit (long-lived `lazySingleton`, `chat_injection.dart:50-53`), not on `ChatReady` itself, so switching sessions doesn't require threading every other session's offset through the active state.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass, including new cubit/drawer tests

---
title: 'Story 6.2 — Multi-Session Chat History & New Conversation'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: ['{project-root}/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-6-context.md']
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Home/Chat (story 6.1) hard-codes a single auto-bootstrapped session with no way to see past sessions or start a fresh one; `AppDrawer` has no session list at all, just a dead "Novo Chat" button.

**Approach:** Add `ChatCubit.switchSession`/`startNewSession` methods that reuse the existing `listSessions()`/`createSession()` repository calls (already backend-correct — no data-layer change needed), carry the session list and a per-session scroll offset on `ChatReady`, and wire `AppDrawer`'s missing "CONVERSAS" section to read/call that same cubit instance via the `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>` already wrapping the drawer's `Scaffold`.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Drawer reads `context.read<ChatCubit>()`/`BlocBuilder` — the instance `ChatScreen` already provides via `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value` (`chat_screen.dart:83-87`); never a second `sl<ChatCubit>()` inside `AppDrawer`.
- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` return `Future<Either<Failure, void>>`, `await`ed by their `AppDrawer` tap handlers (closes a gap spec-6-1's review flagged: a cubit action's result must be observed by its caller).
- Offline "Novo Chat" leaves the current session untouched; caller shows a transient `SnackBar`, not a dedicated offline banner (Story 6.3's job).
- Scroll-offset restore is in-memory only, keyed by `sessionId`, on `ChatCubit` (never Hive) — survives session switches within one app run, resets on restart.
- Reuse `_DrawerNavItem`'s tokens (`drawerNavItemPadding`, `textBodyMd`, `textMonoCaption`) — no new design tokens.
- An empty `title` renders fallback label "Nova conversa" (contract leaves an untitled session's `title` undocumented).

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:** session rename/delete (no endpoint); paginating past the backend's default first page; Story 6.3's offline composer lock/banner; persisting scroll offset or active-session choice across app restarts.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Switch session | Drawer open, tap a past session row | `ChatReady` updates to that session's history; scroll jumps to its last recorded offset (or bottom if none) | N/A |
| New session online | Tap "Novo Chat" while online | `POST /chat/sessions` succeeds; new empty session becomes active, composer focused, drawer closes | N/A |
| New session offline | Tap "Novo Chat" while offline | `createSession()` resolves `Left(Failure.networkOffline)`; current session stays active, drawer closes, `SnackBar` shown | `Failure.networkOffline` surfaced, no crash |
| Switch to already-active session | Tap the currently open session's own row | No-op reload; drawer just closes | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart:40-69` -- `ChatReady`: add `sessions: List<ChatSession>` and `restoreScrollOffset: double?`, extend `copyWith`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart:64-114` (`_bootstrap`) -- capture the resolved sessions list into the emitted `ChatReady`; add `Map<String, double> _scrollOffsets`, `recordScrollOffset(double)`, `switchSession(String sessionId)`, `startNewSession()` (mirror `_bootstrap`'s match-based error handling, lines 92-113).
- `lib/features/chat/domain/repositories/chat_repository.dart:21,31` -- `listSessions()`/`createSession()` signatures, reused as-is, no change.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart:17-131` -- import `flutter_bloc`, `ChatCubit`, `ChatState`, `ChatSession`; wrap body in `BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>`; insert a "CONVERSAS" section (mirrors the bordered nav-items `Container`, lines 78-108) between `_DrawerPrimaryAction` (65-71) and that `Container`, built only when `state is ChatReady`; wire `_DrawerPrimaryAction.onTap` (70) to `startNewSession()`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart:33,59-79` -- on a `ChatReady` with non-null `restoreScrollOffset`, `jumpTo` it once instead of `_scrollToBottomSoon()`; add a scroll listener calling `cubit.recordScrollOffset`.
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1071-1155` -- `chat.sessions.list` response/cursor shape, confirms no rename/delete endpoint exists.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:128-156` -- `_FakeChatRepository`, the DI-override pattern to extend for drawer/cubit tests.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart` -- add `sessions`/`restoreScrollOffset` to `ChatReady` -- carries drawer + scroll-restore data without a second state container (AD-12-consistent).
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart` -- add `switchSession`, `startNewSession`, `recordScrollOffset`; update `_bootstrap` to populate `sessions` -- single cubit stays the one source of truth for session list + active session.
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- render the CONVERSAS list from `ChatReady.sessions`, wire tap → `switchSession`/`startNewSession`, `await` + `SnackBar` on `Left` -- closes the "no CONVERSAS list" gap (doc comment lines 8-16).
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart` -- scroll-offset capture + restore-on-switch -- fulfils the "returning session restores last scroll position" AC.
- [ ] `test/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit_test.dart` -- unit-test `switchSession`/`startNewSession`/offline-create/no-op-on-same-session per the I/O matrix.
- [ ] `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` (new) -- widget tests for CONVERSAS list rendering, tap-to-switch, "Novo Chat" offline `SnackBar`, mirroring `_FakeChatRepository` (`app_router_test.dart:128-156`).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given existing Chat Sessions, when I open the side menu, then they're listed under "CONVERSAS" and tapping one switches the active conversation.
- Given I tap "Novo Chat", when the new session is created, then it opens empty, composer focused, placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...".
- Given I'm offline, when I tap "Novo Chat", then no session is created, the current conversation is untouched, and I see an error message.
- Given I switch back to a session I was previously scrolled up in, when it loads, then it restores that scroll position instead of jumping to the bottom.

## Design Notes

- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` don't re-emit `ChatBootstrapLoading` — swapping sessions keeps the drawer-closing transition feeling instant; a transient loading flicker isn't worth a 4th visible chat state (Boundaries: "exactly three visible message states" governs bubbles, not session-switch chrome).
- `_scrollOffsets` lives on the cubit (long-lived `lazySingleton`, `chat_injection.dart:50-53`), not on `ChatReady` itself, so switching sessions doesn't require threading every other session's offset through the active state.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass, including new cubit/drawer tests

## Intent

**Problem:** Home/Chat (story 6.1) hard-codes a single auto-bootstrapped session with no way to see past sessions or start a fresh one; `AppDrawer` has no session list at all, just a dead "Novo Chat" button.

**Approach:** Add `ChatCubit.switchSession`/`startNewSession` methods that reuse the existing `listSessions()`/`createSession()` repository calls (already backend-correct — no data-layer change needed), carry the session list and a per-session scroll offset on `ChatReady`, and wire `AppDrawer`'s missing "CONVERSAS" section to read/call that same cubit instance via the `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>` already wrapping the drawer's `Scaffold`.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Drawer reads `context.read<ChatCubit>()`/`BlocBuilder` — the instance `ChatScreen` already provides via `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value` (`chat_screen.dart:83-87`); never a second `sl<ChatCubit>()` inside `AppDrawer`.
- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` return `Future<Either<Failure, void>>`, `await`ed by their `AppDrawer` tap handlers (closes a gap spec-6-1's review flagged: a cubit action's result must be observed by its caller).
- Offline "Novo Chat" leaves the current session untouched; caller shows a transient `SnackBar`, not a dedicated offline banner (Story 6.3's job).
- Scroll-offset restore is in-memory only, keyed by `sessionId`, on `ChatCubit` (never Hive) — survives session switches within one app run, resets on restart.
- Reuse `_DrawerNavItem`'s tokens (`drawerNavItemPadding`, `textBodyMd`, `textMonoCaption`) — no new design tokens.
- An empty `title` renders fallback label "Nova conversa" (contract leaves an untitled session's `title` undocumented).

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:** session rename/delete (no endpoint); paginating past the backend's default first page; Story 6.3's offline composer lock/banner; persisting scroll offset or active-session choice across app restarts.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Switch session | Drawer open, tap a past session row | `ChatReady` updates to that session's history; scroll jumps to its last recorded offset (or bottom if none) | N/A |
| New session online | Tap "Novo Chat" while online | `POST /chat/sessions` succeeds; new empty session becomes active, composer focused, drawer closes | N/A |
| New session offline | Tap "Novo Chat" while offline | `createSession()` resolves `Left(Failure.networkOffline)`; current session stays active, drawer closes, `SnackBar` shown | `Failure.networkOffline` surfaced, no crash |
| Switch to already-active session | Tap the currently open session's own row | No-op reload; drawer just closes | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart:40-69` -- `ChatReady`: add `sessions: List<ChatSession>`, `restoreScrollOffset: double?`; extend `copyWith`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart:64-114` (`_bootstrap`) -- capture resolved sessions into the emitted `ChatReady`; add `Map<String, double> _scrollOffsets`, `recordScrollOffset`, `switchSession`, `startNewSession` (mirror `_bootstrap`'s match-based error handling, lines 92-113).
- `lib/features/chat/domain/repositories/chat_repository.dart:21,31` -- `listSessions()`/`createSession()`, reused as-is.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart:17-131` -- wrap body in `BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>`; insert a "CONVERSAS" section (mirrors bordered `Container`, lines 78-108) between `_DrawerPrimaryAction` (65-71) and it, shown only when `state is ChatReady`; wire `_DrawerPrimaryAction.onTap` (70) to `startNewSession()`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart:33,59-79` -- on `ChatReady.restoreScrollOffset != null`, `jumpTo` it once instead of `_scrollToBottomSoon()`; add a listener calling `cubit.recordScrollOffset`.
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1071-1155` -- confirms no rename/delete/pagination-required endpoint.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:128-156` -- `_FakeChatRepository`, the DI-override pattern to extend.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart` -- add `sessions`/`restoreScrollOffset` to `ChatReady` -- carries drawer + scroll-restore data without a second state container (AD-12-consistent).
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart` -- add `switchSession`, `startNewSession`, `recordScrollOffset`; update `_bootstrap` to populate `sessions` -- single cubit stays the one source of truth for session list + active session.
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- render the CONVERSAS list from `ChatReady.sessions`, wire tap → `switchSession`/`startNewSession`, `await` + `SnackBar` on `Left` -- closes the "no CONVERSAS list" gap (doc comment lines 8-16).
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart` -- scroll-offset capture + restore-on-switch -- fulfils the "returning session restores last scroll position" AC.
- [ ] `test/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit_test.dart` -- unit-test `switchSession`/`startNewSession`/offline-create/no-op-on-same-session per the I/O matrix.
- [ ] `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` (new) -- widget tests for CONVERSAS list rendering, tap-to-switch, "Novo Chat" offline `SnackBar`, mirroring `_FakeChatRepository` (`app_router_test.dart:128-156`).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given existing Chat Sessions, when I open the side menu, then they're listed under "CONVERSAS" and tapping one switches the active conversation.
- Given I tap "Novo Chat", when the new session is created, then it opens empty, composer focused, placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...".
- Given I'm offline, when I tap "Novo Chat", then no session is created, the current conversation is untouched, and I see an error message.
- Given I switch back to a session I was previously scrolled up in, when it loads, then it restores that scroll position instead of jumping to the bottom.

## Design Notes

- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` don't re-emit `ChatBootstrapLoading` — swapping sessions keeps the drawer-closing transition feeling instant; a transient loading flicker isn't worth a 4th visible chat state (Boundaries: "exactly three visible message states" governs bubbles, not session-switch chrome).
- `_scrollOffsets` lives on the cubit (long-lived `lazySingleton`, `chat_injection.dart:50-53`), not on `ChatReady` itself, so switching sessions doesn't require threading every other session's offset through the active state.

---
title: 'Story 6.2 — Multi-Session Chat History & New Conversation'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: ['{project-root}/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-6-context.md']
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Home/Chat (story 6.1) hard-codes a single auto-bootstrapped session with no way to see past sessions or start a fresh one; `AppDrawer` has no session list at all, just a dead "Novo Chat" button.

**Approach:** Add `ChatCubit.switchSession`/`startNewSession` methods that reuse the existing `listSessions()`/`createSession()` repository calls (already backend-correct — no data-layer change needed), carry the session list and a per-session scroll offset on `ChatReady`, and wire `AppDrawer`'s missing "CONVERSAS" section to read/call that same cubit instance via the `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>` already wrapping the drawer's `Scaffold`.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Drawer reads `context.read<ChatCubit>()`/`BlocBuilder` — the instance `ChatScreen` already provides via `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value` (`chat_screen.dart:83-87`); never a second `sl<ChatCubit>()` inside `AppDrawer`.
- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` return `Future<Either<Failure, void>>`, `await`ed by their `AppDrawer` tap handlers (closes a gap spec-6-1's review flagged: a cubit action's result must be observed by its caller).
- Offline "Novo Chat" leaves the current session untouched; caller shows a transient `SnackBar`, not a dedicated offline banner (Story 6.3's job).
- Scroll-offset restore is in-memory only, keyed by `sessionId`, on `ChatCubit` (never Hive) — survives session switches within one app run, resets on restart.
- Reuse `_DrawerNavItem`'s tokens (`drawerNavItemPadding`, `textBodyMd`, `textMonoCaption`) — no new design tokens.
- An empty `title` renders fallback label "Nova conversa" (contract leaves an untitled session's `title` undocumented).

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:** session rename/delete (no endpoint); paginating past the backend's default first page; Story 6.3's offline composer lock/banner; persisting scroll offset or active-session choice across app restarts.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Switch session | Drawer open, tap a past session row | `ChatReady` updates to that session's history; scroll jumps to its last recorded offset (or bottom if none) | N/A |
| New session online | Tap "Novo Chat" while online | `POST /chat/sessions` succeeds; new empty session becomes active, composer focused, drawer closes | N/A |
| New session offline | Tap "Novo Chat" while offline | `createSession()` resolves `Left(Failure.networkOffline)`; current session stays active, drawer closes, `SnackBar` shown | `Failure.networkOffline` surfaced, no crash |
| Switch to already-active session | Tap the currently open session's own row | No-op reload; drawer just closes | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart:40-69` -- `ChatReady`: add `sessions: List<ChatSession>`, `restoreScrollOffset: double?`; extend `copyWith`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart:64-114` (`_bootstrap`) -- capture resolved sessions into the emitted `ChatReady`; add `Map<String, double> _scrollOffsets`, `recordScrollOffset`, `switchSession`, `startNewSession` (mirror `_bootstrap`'s match-based error handling, lines 92-113).
- `lib/features/chat/domain/repositories/chat_repository.dart:21,31` -- `listSessions()`/`createSession()`, reused as-is.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart:17-131` -- wrap body in `BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>`; insert a "CONVERSAS" section (mirrors bordered `Container`, lines 78-108) between `_DrawerPrimaryAction` (65-71) and it, shown only when `state is ChatReady`; wire `_DrawerPrimaryAction.onTap` (70) to `startNewSession()`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart:33,59-79` -- on `ChatReady.restoreScrollOffset != null`, `jumpTo` it once instead of `_scrollToBottomSoon()`; add a listener calling `cubit.recordScrollOffset`.
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1071-1155` -- confirms no rename/delete/pagination-required endpoint.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:128-156` -- `_FakeChatRepository`, the DI-override pattern to extend.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart` -- add `sessions`/`restoreScrollOffset` to `ChatReady` -- no second state container (AD-12).
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart` -- add `switchSession`, `startNewSession`, `recordScrollOffset`; populate `sessions` in `_bootstrap` -- one cubit stays the source of truth.
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- render CONVERSAS from `ChatReady.sessions`, wire tap → `switchSession`/`startNewSession`, `await` + `SnackBar` on `Left` -- closes the gap at doc-comment lines 8-16.
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart` -- scroll-offset capture + restore-on-switch -- fulfils the scroll-position AC.
- [ ] `test/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit_test.dart` -- unit-test `switchSession`/`startNewSession`/offline-create/no-op-on-same-session per the I/O matrix.
- [ ] `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` (new) -- widget tests: CONVERSAS rendering, tap-to-switch, offline `SnackBar`, mirroring `_FakeChatRepository` (`app_router_test.dart:128-156`).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given existing Chat Sessions, when I open the side menu, then they're listed under "CONVERSAS" and tapping one switches the active conversation.
- Given I tap "Novo Chat", when the new session is created, then it opens empty, composer focused, placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...".
- Given I'm offline, when I tap "Novo Chat", then no session is created, the current conversation is untouched, and I see an error message.
- Given I switch back to a session I was previously scrolled up in, when it loads, then it restores that scroll position instead of jumping to the bottom.

## Design Notes

- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` don't re-emit `ChatBootstrapLoading` — a transient flicker isn't worth a 4th visible chat state ("exactly three" governs bubbles, not session-switch chrome). `_scrollOffsets` lives on the long-lived cubit (`chat_injection.dart:50-53`), not on `ChatReady`, so switching never threads every other session's offset through the active state.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass, including new cubit/drawer tests

title: 'Story 6.2 — Multi-Session Chat History & New Conversation'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: ['{project-root}/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-6-context.md']
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Home/Chat (story 6.1) hard-codes a single auto-bootstrapped session with no way to see past sessions or start a fresh one; `AppDrawer` has no session list at all, just a dead "Novo Chat" button.

**Approach:** Add `ChatCubit.switchSession`/`startNewSession` methods that reuse the existing `listSessions()`/`createSession()` repository calls (already backend-correct — no data-layer change needed), carry the session list and a per-session scroll offset on `ChatReady`, and wire `AppDrawer`'s missing "CONVERSAS" section to read/call that same cubit instance via the `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>` already wrapping the drawer's `Scaffold`.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Drawer reads `context.read<ChatCubit>()`/`BlocBuilder` — the instance `ChatScreen` already provides via `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value` (`chat_screen.dart:83-87`); never a second `sl<ChatCubit>()` inside `AppDrawer`.
- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` return `Future<Either<Failure, void>>`, `await`ed by their `AppDrawer` tap handlers (closes a gap spec-6-1's review flagged: a cubit action's result must be observed by its caller).
- Offline "Novo Chat" leaves the current session untouched; caller shows a transient `SnackBar`, not a dedicated offline banner (Story 6.3's job).
- Scroll-offset restore is in-memory only, keyed by `sessionId`, on `ChatCubit` (never Hive) — survives session switches within one app run, resets on restart.
- Reuse `_DrawerNavItem`'s tokens (`drawerNavItemPadding`, `textBodyMd`, `textMonoCaption`) — no new design tokens.
- An empty `title` renders fallback label "Nova conversa" (contract leaves an untitled session's `title` undocumented).

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:** session rename/delete (no endpoint); paginating past the backend's default first page; Story 6.3's offline composer lock/banner; persisting scroll offset or active-session choice across app restarts.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Switch session | Drawer open, tap a past session row | `ChatReady` updates to that session's history; scroll jumps to its last recorded offset (or bottom if none) | N/A |
| New session online | Tap "Novo Chat" while online | `POST /chat/sessions` succeeds; new empty session becomes active, composer focused, drawer closes | N/A |
| New session offline | Tap "Novo Chat" while offline | `createSession()` resolves `Left(Failure.networkOffline)`; current session stays active, drawer closes, `SnackBar` shown | `Failure.networkOffline` surfaced, no crash |
| Switch to already-active session | Tap the currently open session's own row | No-op reload; drawer just closes | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart:40-69` -- `ChatReady`: add `sessions: List<ChatSession>`, `restoreScrollOffset: double?`; extend `copyWith`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart:64-114` (`_bootstrap`) -- capture resolved sessions into the emitted `ChatReady`; add `Map<String, double> _scrollOffsets`, `recordScrollOffset`, `switchSession`, `startNewSession` (mirror `_bootstrap`'s match-based error handling, lines 92-113).
- `lib/features/chat/domain/repositories/chat_repository.dart:21,31` -- `listSessions()`/`createSession()`, reused as-is.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart:17-131` -- wrap body in `BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>`; insert a "CONVERSAS" section (mirrors bordered `Container`, lines 78-108) between `_DrawerPrimaryAction` (65-71) and it, shown only when `state is ChatReady`; wire `_DrawerPrimaryAction.onTap` (70) to `startNewSession()`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart:33,59-79` -- on `ChatReady.restoreScrollOffset != null`, `jumpTo` it once instead of `_scrollToBottomSoon()`; add a listener calling `cubit.recordScrollOffset`.
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1071-1155` -- confirms no rename/delete/pagination-required endpoint.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:128-156` -- `_FakeChatRepository`, the DI-override pattern to extend.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart` -- add `sessions`/`restoreScrollOffset` to `ChatReady` -- no second state container (AD-12).
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart` -- add `switchSession`, `startNewSession`, `recordScrollOffset`; populate `sessions` in `_bootstrap` -- one cubit stays the source of truth.
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- render CONVERSAS from `ChatReady.sessions`, wire tap → `switchSession`/`startNewSession`, `await` + `SnackBar` on `Left` -- closes the gap at doc-comment lines 8-16.
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart` -- scroll-offset capture + restore-on-switch -- fulfils the scroll-position AC.
- [ ] `test/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit_test.dart` -- unit-test `switchSession`/`startNewSession`/offline-create/no-op-on-same-session per the I/O matrix.
- [ ] `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` (new) -- widget tests: CONVERSAS rendering, tap-to-switch, offline `SnackBar`, mirroring `_FakeChatRepository` (`app_router_test.dart:128-156`).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given existing Chat Sessions, when I open the side menu, then they're listed under "CONVERSAS" and tapping one switches the active conversation.
- Given I tap "Novo Chat", when the new session is created, then it opens empty, composer focused, placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...".
- Given I'm offline, when I tap "Novo Chat", then no session is created, the current conversation is untouched, and I see an error message.
- Given I switch back to a session I was previously scrolled up in, when it loads, then it restores that scroll position instead of jumping to the bottom.

## Design Notes

- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` don't re-emit `ChatBootstrapLoading` (a 4th visible state isn't worth it — "exactly three" governs bubbles, not session-switch chrome). `_scrollOffsets` lives on the long-lived cubit (`chat_injection.dart:50-53`), not `ChatReady`.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass, including new cubit/drawer tests

**Approach:** Add `ChatCubit.switchSession`/`startNewSession` methods that reuse the existing `listSessions()`/`createSession()` repository calls (already backend-correct — no data-layer change needed), carry the session list and a per-session scroll offset on `ChatReady`, and wire `AppDrawer`'s missing "CONVERSAS" section to read/call that same cubit instance via the `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>` already wrapping the drawer's `Scaffold`.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Drawer reads `context.read<ChatCubit>()`/`BlocBuilder` — the instance `ChatScreen` already provides via `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value` (`chat_screen.dart:83-87`); never a second `sl<ChatCubit>()` inside `AppDrawer`.
- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` return `Future<Either<Failure, void>>`, `await`ed by their `AppDrawer` tap handlers (closes a gap spec-6-1's review flagged: a cubit action's result must be observed by its caller).
- Offline "Novo Chat" leaves the current session untouched; caller shows a transient `SnackBar`, not a dedicated offline banner (Story 6.3's job).
- Scroll-offset restore is in-memory only, keyed by `sessionId`, on `ChatCubit` (never Hive) — survives session switches within one app run, resets on restart.
- Reuse `_DrawerNavItem`'s tokens (`drawerNavItemPadding`, `textBodyMd`, `textMonoCaption`) — no new design tokens.
- An empty `title` renders fallback label "Nova conversa" (contract leaves an untitled session's `title` undocumented).

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:** session rename/delete (no endpoint); paginating past the backend's default first page; Story 6.3's offline composer lock/banner; persisting scroll offset or active-session choice across app restarts.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Switch session | Drawer open, tap a past session row | `ChatReady` updates to that session's history; scroll jumps to its last recorded offset (or bottom if none) | N/A |
| New session online | Tap "Novo Chat" while online | `POST /chat/sessions` succeeds; new empty session becomes active, composer focused, drawer closes | N/A |
| New session offline | Tap "Novo Chat" while offline | `createSession()` resolves `Left(Failure.networkOffline)`; current session stays active, drawer closes, `SnackBar` shown | `Failure.networkOffline` surfaced, no crash |
| Switch to already-active session | Tap the currently open session's own row | No-op reload; drawer just closes | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart:40-69` -- `ChatReady`: add `sessions: List<ChatSession>`, `restoreScrollOffset: double?`; extend `copyWith`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart:64-114` (`_bootstrap`) -- capture resolved sessions into the emitted `ChatReady`; add `Map<String, double> _scrollOffsets`, `recordScrollOffset`, `switchSession`, `startNewSession` (mirror `_bootstrap`'s match-based error handling, lines 92-113).
- `lib/features/chat/domain/repositories/chat_repository.dart:21,31` -- `listSessions()`/`createSession()`, reused as-is.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart:17-131` -- wrap body in `BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>`; insert a "CONVERSAS" section (mirrors bordered `Container`, lines 78-108) between `_DrawerPrimaryAction` (65-71) and it, shown only when `state is ChatReady`; wire `_DrawerPrimaryAction.onTap` (70) to `startNewSession()`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart:33,59-79` -- on `ChatReady.restoreScrollOffset != null`, `jumpTo` it once instead of `_scrollToBottomSoon()`; add a listener calling `cubit.recordScrollOffset`.
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1071-1155` -- confirms no rename/delete/pagination-required endpoint.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:128-156` -- `_FakeChatRepository`, the DI-override pattern to extend.

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart` -- add `sessions`/`restoreScrollOffset` to `ChatReady` -- no second state container (AD-12).
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart` -- add `switchSession`, `startNewSession`, `recordScrollOffset`; populate `sessions` in `_bootstrap` -- one cubit stays the source of truth.
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- render CONVERSAS from `ChatReady.sessions`, wire tap → `switchSession`/`startNewSession`, `await` + `SnackBar` on `Left` -- closes the gap at doc-comment lines 8-16.
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart` -- scroll-offset capture + restore-on-switch -- fulfils the scroll-position AC.
- [ ] `test/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit_test.dart` -- unit-test `switchSession`/`startNewSession`/offline-create/no-op-on-same-session per the I/O matrix.
- [ ] `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` (new) -- widget tests: CONVERSAS rendering, tap-to-switch, offline `SnackBar`, mirroring `_FakeChatRepository` (`app_router_test.dart:128-156`).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given existing Chat Sessions, when I open the side menu, then they're listed under "CONVERSAS" and tapping one switches the active conversation.
- Given I tap "Novo Chat", when the new session is created, then it opens empty, composer focused, placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...".
- Given I'm offline, when I tap "Novo Chat", then no session is created, the current conversation is untouched, and I see an error message.
- Given I switch back to a session I was previously scrolled up in, when it loads, then it restores that scroll position instead of jumping to the bottom.

## Design Notes

- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` don't re-emit `ChatBootstrapLoading` (a 4th visible state isn't worth it — "exactly three" governs bubbles, not session-switch chrome). `_scrollOffsets` lives on the long-lived cubit (`chat_injection.dart:50-53`), not `ChatReady`.

- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass, including new cubit/drawer tests

# Sync Sprint Status

Shared sub-step for updating `sprint-status.yaml` during build. Called from any route (plan-code-review, one-shot, future routes) with a `target_status` parameter.

## Preconditions

Skip this entire file (return to caller) if ANY of:
- `story_key` is unset
- `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml` does not exist on disk

## Instructions

1. Load the FULL `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml` file.
2. Find the `development_status` entry matching `{story_key}`. If not found, warn the user once (`"{story_key} not found in sprint-status; skipping sprint sync"`) and return to caller.
3. **Idempotency check.** If `development_status[{story_key}]` is already at `target_status` or a later state (`review` is later than `in-progress`; `done` is later than both), return to caller — no write needed. Never regress a story's status.
4. Set `development_status[{story_key}]` to `{target_status}`.
5. **Epic lift (only when `target_status` = `in-progress`).** Derive the parent epic key as `epic-{N}` from the leading numeric segment of `{story_key}` (e.g., `3-2-digest-delivery` → `epic-3`). If that entry exists and is `backlog`, set it to `in-progress`. Leave it alone otherwise. Skip this sub-step entirely when `target_status` is not `in-progress`.
6. Refresh `last_updated` to the current date.
7. Save the file, preserving ALL comments and structure including STATUS DEFINITIONS and WORKFLOW NOTES.

  Implemented spec-6-2 (Multi-Session Chat History & New Conversation) in full. Summary of changes, verification, and two deliberate deviations below.
  
  ## Files changed
  
  - `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart` — `ChatReady` gained `sessions: List<ChatSession>` and `restoreScrollOffset: double?`; `copyWith` extended to carry both.
  - `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart`
    - `_bootstrap()` now captures the resolved session list (including a freshly created one) into the emitted `ChatReady.sessions`.
    - Added `final Map<String, double> _scrollOffsets = {}` (in-memory, keyed by sessionId, lives on the long-lived cubit — never Hive, never ChatReady).
    - Added `recordScrollOffset(sessionId, offset)`.
    - Added `switchSession(sessionId) -> Future<Either<Failure, Unit>>`: no-op `Right` if already active; otherwise fetches history via the existing `listMessages`, emits a new `ChatReady` carrying whatever `_scrollOffsets[sessionId]` holds (or `null`).
    - Added `startNewSession() -> Future<Either<Failure, Unit>>`: calls existing `createSession()`; on `Left` (including offline) nothing is emitted at all — current session untouched; on success, new empty session becomes active, prepended to `sessions`.
  - `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` — rewritten to read `context.read<ChatCubit>()`/`BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>` (the instance `ChatScreen` already provides via `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value`, never a second `sl<ChatCubit>()`). Added a "CONVERSAS" section (`_ConversasSection`/`_DrawerSessionItem`, reusing `drawerNavItemPadding`/`textBodyMd`/`textMonoCaption`/`spacingXs`/`spacingSm` — no new design tokens) listing every session title+timestamp, sorted most-recent-first, empty title falling back to "Nova conversa". Wired "Novo Chat" to `startNewSession()` and each row to `switchSession()`, both `await`ed with the `Left` surfaced as a `ScaffoldMessenger` `SnackBar` (`failure.message` verbatim, same convention `TextEntryError`/`MeusRegistrosError` already use); drawer closes either way. The CONVERSAS + static-nav block now scrolls as one unit (`Expanded`+`SingleChildScrollView`) so a longer session list can't overflow the fixed-height `Drawer`.
  - `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart` — added a `ScrollController` listener that calls `cubit.recordScrollOffset` continuously; the `BlocConsumer` listener now tracks `_lastSessionId` to distinguish "the active session just changed" from an ordinary in-session update, jumping to `restoreScrollOffset` (or the bottom, if `null`) only on the former, and requesting focus on a new `FocusNode` (`_composerFocusNode`, now threaded through `_ChatComposer`) when a session switch lands on zero messages — this satisfies AC2 ("composer focused" on a fresh "Novo Chat") without any new cubit API.
  - `test/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit_test.dart` — new group covering: switching fetches and activates the target session; switching to the already-active session is a no-op `Right` (identical state object, no re-fetch); a switch failure surfaces as `Left` with the old session still active; `recordScrollOffset`/`restoreScrollOffset` round-trip (including the "never recorded -> null" fallback); `startNewSession` online success (new empty session, prepended to `sessions`); offline failure (state object untouched, `Left(NetworkOffline)`).
  - `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` — this file already existed (Story 1.6), asserting the *old* "no CONVERSAS section, Novo Chat is a dead no-op" behavior, so I rewrote it in place rather than creating a duplicate. It now wraps the test route in `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value` with a controllable fake `ChatRepository` (mirroring the pattern at `app_router_test.dart:128-156`) and covers: CONVERSAS rendering (+ "Nova conversa" fallback), tap-to-switch, no-op on the already-active row, "Novo Chat" online success, "Novo Chat" offline (untouched session + SnackBar text), plus the pre-existing header/nav/width assertions (unchanged).
  
  ## Verification
  
  - `fvm flutter analyze` — 0 issues.
  - `fvm flutter test` — all 915 tests pass (full suite, including the untouched pre-existing `chat_flow_e2e_test.dart`, `chat_screen_test.dart`, `app_router_test.dart`).
  - `fvm flutter pub get` — resolves cleanly, no conflicts.
  - No `build_runner` run needed — no new/changed `freezed`/`json_serializable` types.
  
  ## Two deliberate, low-risk deviations from the spec's literal wording
  
  1. Spec/Boundaries says `switchSession`/`startNewSession` return `Future<Either<Failure, void>>`. I used `Future<Either<Failure, Unit>>` (fpdart's `Unit`) instead — using `void` as the generic `Right` type triggers Dart's `void_checks` lint (`return right(unit)` reads as "assignment to a variable of type void"), which fails AGENTS.md's hard "`flutter analyze` must report zero issues" requirement. `Either<Failure, Unit>` is also the codebase's own existing convention for this exact shape (`SessionRepository.restoreSession`, `AccountSettingsRepository.setBiometricEnabled`, `VaultRepository.authenticate`/`submitPin` all do this). Behavior is identical; only the type-parameter spelling differs.
  2. The Code Map labeled `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` "(new)" — it was not; it already existed from Story 1.6 testing the drawer's pre-session behavior. I extended/rewrote it in place instead of creating a second file, since the old assertions ("no CONVERSAS section", "Novo Chat is a no-op") are now literally false and would otherwise fail.
  
  ## Nothing left incomplete against this spec's scope
  
  Session rename/delete, pagination past the first page, and Story 6.3's offline composer lock/banner were explicitly out of scope and are not touched. The only thing I added beyond the Code Map's literal file list is a `FocusNode` in `ChatScreen`/`_ChatComposer` — required by Acceptance Criterion 2 ("opens empty, composer focused") but not called out in the Code Map's per-file breakdown; it's fully contained within `chat_screen.dart`, no new cubit surface.

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Home/Chat (story 6.1) hard-codes a single auto-bootstrapped session with no way to see past sessions or start a fresh one; `AppDrawer` has no session list at all, just a dead "Novo Chat" button.

**Approach:** Add `ChatCubit.switchSession`/`startNewSession` methods that reuse the existing `listSessions()`/`createSession()` repository calls (already backend-correct — no data-layer change needed), carry the session list and a per-session scroll offset on `ChatReady`, and wire `AppDrawer`'s missing "CONVERSAS" section to read/call that same cubit instance via the `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>` already wrapping the drawer's `Scaffold`.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Drawer reads `context.read<ChatCubit>()`/`BlocBuilder` — the instance `ChatScreen` already provides via `BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value` (`chat_screen.dart:83-87`); never a second `sl<ChatCubit>()` inside `AppDrawer`.
- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` return `Future<Either<Failure, void>>`, `await`ed by their `AppDrawer` tap handlers (closes a gap spec-6-1's review flagged: a cubit action's result must be observed by its caller).
- Offline "Novo Chat" leaves the current session untouched; caller shows a transient `SnackBar`, not a dedicated offline banner (Story 6.3's job).
- Scroll-offset restore is in-memory only, keyed by `sessionId`, on `ChatCubit` (never Hive) — survives session switches within one app run, resets on restart.
- Reuse `_DrawerNavItem`'s tokens (`drawerNavItemPadding`, `textBodyMd`, `textMonoCaption`) — no new design tokens.
- An empty `title` renders fallback label "Nova conversa" (contract leaves an untitled session's `title` undocumented).

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:** session rename/delete (no endpoint); paginating past the backend's default first page; Story 6.3's offline composer lock/banner; persisting scroll offset or active-session choice across app restarts.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Switch session | Drawer open, tap a past session row | `ChatReady` updates to that session's history; scroll jumps to its last recorded offset (or bottom if none) | N/A |
| New session online | Tap "Novo Chat" while online | `POST /chat/sessions` succeeds; new empty session becomes active, composer focused, drawer closes | N/A |
| New session offline | Tap "Novo Chat" while offline | `createSession()` resolves `Left(Failure.networkOffline)`; current session stays active, drawer closes, `SnackBar` shown | `Failure.networkOffline` surfaced, no crash |
| Switch to already-active session | Tap the currently open session's own row | No-op reload; drawer just closes | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart:40-69` -- `ChatReady`: add `sessions: List<ChatSession>`, `restoreScrollOffset: double?`; extend `copyWith`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart:64-114` (`_bootstrap`) -- capture resolved sessions into the emitted `ChatReady`; add `Map<String, double> _scrollOffsets`, `recordScrollOffset`, `switchSession`, `startNewSession` (mirror `_bootstrap`'s match-based error handling, lines 92-113).
- `lib/features/chat/domain/repositories/chat_repository.dart:21,31` -- `listSessions()`/`createSession()`, reused as-is.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart:17-131` -- wrap body in `BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>`; insert a "CONVERSAS" section (mirrors bordered `Container`, lines 78-108) between `_DrawerPrimaryAction` (65-71) and it, shown only when `state is ChatReady`; wire `_DrawerPrimaryAction.onTap` (70) to `startNewSession()`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart:33,59-79` -- on `ChatReady.restoreScrollOffset != null`, `jumpTo` it once instead of `_scrollToBottomSoon()`; add a listener calling `cubit.recordScrollOffset`.
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1071-1155` -- confirms no rename/delete/pagination-required endpoint.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:128-156` -- `_FakeChatRepository`, the DI-override pattern to extend.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart` -- add `sessions`/`restoreScrollOffset` to `ChatReady` -- no second state container (AD-12).
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart` -- add `switchSession`, `startNewSession`, `recordScrollOffset`; populate `sessions` in `_bootstrap` -- one cubit stays the source of truth.
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- render CONVERSAS from `ChatReady.sessions`, wire tap → `switchSession`/`startNewSession`, `await` + `SnackBar` on `Left` -- closes the gap at doc-comment lines 8-16.
- [ ] `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart` -- scroll-offset capture + restore-on-switch -- fulfils the scroll-position AC.
- [ ] `test/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit_test.dart` -- unit-test `switchSession`/`startNewSession`/offline-create/no-op-on-same-session per the I/O matrix.
- [ ] `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` (new) -- widget tests: CONVERSAS rendering, tap-to-switch, offline `SnackBar`, mirroring `_FakeChatRepository` (`app_router_test.dart:128-156`).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given existing Chat Sessions, when I open the side menu, then they're listed under "CONVERSAS" and tapping one switches the active conversation.
- Given I tap "Novo Chat", when the new session is created, then it opens empty, composer focused, placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...".
- Given I'm offline, when I tap "Novo Chat", then no session is created, the current conversation is untouched, and I see an error message.
- Given I switch back to a session I was previously scrolled up in, when it loads, then it restores that scroll position instead of jumping to the bottom.

## Design Notes

- `switchSession`/`startNewSession` don't re-emit `ChatBootstrapLoading` (a 4th visible state isn't worth it — "exactly three" governs bubbles, not session-switch chrome). `_scrollOffsets` lives on the long-lived cubit (`chat_injection.dart:50-53`), not `ChatReady`.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass, including new cubit/drawer tests
